simulation_adaptations: Original bytes retained. Runtime planet-only clipping, alignment, scaling and telescope blur; nearest rotational aspect repeats every 9.925 hours. Computed moons and approximate shadows are composited independently. Views 04–06 excluded. Observation-label times are treated as UTC solely for approximate visual phase; not an absolute longitude calibration.
